leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: Can / Can't
leadIn.content: What can you do? Maria can swim and drive a car, but she can't play the guitar. 'Can' expresses ability and possibility.

instructionCheck.question: Are you interviewing a partner about 5 abilities or working alone?

meaningCheck.question: Function check: What is the primary purpose of using Can / Can't?
options: To express clear, level-appropriate meaning in structured context
To translate sentences word-for-word from another language
It is an obsolete form never used by native speakers
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · This structure provides explicit grammatical function and clarity.

meaningCheck.question: Form check: Does correct usage of Can / Can't require matching subject, verb, and modifier agreements?
options: No, agreement rules are optional in English
Yes, matching grammatical forms ensures natural, accurate communication
Agreement only matters in formal academic writing
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · Accurate form and agreement choices prevent misunderstandings.

form.title: Form & Structure: Can / Can't
form.content: Subject + can / can't + base verb (no 'to', no '-s'). Question: Can + subject + base verb?

controlledPractice.question: Which is correct?
controlledPractice.explanation: Can never takes 'to', and never adds -s: can + base verb.

controlledPractice.question: '___ I open the window, please?' (permission)
controlledPractice.explanation: Can is used to ask for permission politely.
